description: OMOP CDM v5.4 DRUG_EXPOSURE table — records of drugs including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vaccines, and large-molecule biologic therapies. Drugs are mapped to RxNorm concepts.

fields.label: Drug Exposure ID
fields.description: A system-generated unique identifier for each Drug utilization event.

fields.label: Person ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person who is subjected to the Drug. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.label: Drug Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for the Drug concept. These are RxNorm or NDC concepts.

fields.label: Drug Exposure Start Date
fields.description: The start date for the current instance of Drug utilization. Valid entries include a start date of a prescription, the date a prescription was filled, or the date on which a Drug administration was recorded.

fields.label: Drug Exposure Start Datetime
fields.description: The start date and time for the current instance of Drug utilization.

fields.label: Drug Exposure End Date
fields.description: The end date for the current instance of Drug utilization. Reflects the date the patient was expected to have stopped the drug, if known.

fields.label: Drug Exposure End Datetime
fields.description: The end date and time for the current instance of Drug utilization.

fields.label: Drug Type Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the type of Drug Exposure recorded. It indicates how the Drug Exposure was represented in the source data.

fields.label: Stop Reason
fields.description: The reason the Drug was stopped. Reasons include regimen completed, changed, removed, etc.

fields.label: Refills
fields.description: The number of refills after the initial prescription. The initial prescription is not counted, values start with null.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: The quantity of drug as recorded in the original prescription or dispensing record.

fields.label: Days Supply
fields.description: The number of days of supply of the medication as recorded in the original prescription or dispensing record.

fields.label: Sig
fields.description: The directions ('signetur') on the Drug prescription as recorded in the original prescription (and printed on the container) or dispensing record.

fields.label: Route Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a predefined concept in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the route of administration and target organ of the drug.

fields.label: Provider ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the provider in the PROVIDER table who initiated (prescribed, administered) the Drug Exposure.

fields.label: Visit Occurrence ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table during which the Drug Exposure was initiated.

fields.label: Drug Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the drug as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a Standard Drug concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

fields.label: Drug Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.label: Route Source Value
fields.description: The information about the route of administration as detailed in the source.

fields.label: Dose Unit Source Value
fields.description: The information about the dose unit as detailed in the source.
